paragraphs.source_en: Shinsuke was lifted into the air, but under the combined weight of Shinsuke and his own body, Yoshimoto lost his footing. He stumbled and pitched to the ground. The nimble Shinsuke wrenched himself free and pinned Yoshimoto's chest down with both hands.

paragraphs.source_en: The thunderstorm had not yet abated. In the driving rain, Yoshimoto could not make out the face of the warrior astride him. Yet even now he did not realize that the net of death had closed around him, and he continued to struggle. “Quickly, seize the traitor—”

paragraphs.source_en: “Hah!” The warrior astride Yoshimoto's chest roared, “Lord Imagawa, yield me your head!”

paragraphs.source_en: On the afternoon of the nineteenth day of the fifth month in the third year of Eiroku, Imagawa Yoshimoto, Lord of Suruga, Totomi, and Mikawa, bit off one of Mori Shinsuke's fingers; yet beneath Nobunaga's attack, modeled on the tactics of wild warriors, he became a single drop of dew at Okehazama and vanished forever.

units.source_zh: 永禄三年五月十九午后，骏河、远江、三河之守今川义元，咬断了毛利新助的一根手指，却在信长模仿野武士的攻击中，变成了桶狭间的一滴露水，永远消失了。
